Album / Artist: You're Gonna Need A Little Music / Yard Act

Label: Republic Records

Release Date: July 17, 2026

Review Date: 10/8/2026

Reviewer: DJ Stace

General Comments / Reviews:

Yard Act trade some of the sneer for groove, and it works. Dance-punk you can actually dance to. Lots of FCCs, sadly. Still some VERY solid clean tracks- DJ Stace

Release Notes:

Leeds band's third album.

Produced by Justin Meldal-Johnsen (Beck, St. Vincent, Nine Inch Nails); finished at his Los Angeles studio.

released July 17, 2026

FCCs: 1,3,6,7,8,9

RIYL: Fontaines D.C., LCD Soundsystem, The Streets, Parquet Courts

Play: All but FCCs (lots!!), Favs Rated with up to *****

Tracklist:

1. Empty Pledges 04:25 - FCC fuck x1, shit x1, dickhead X1. Driving, clanging opener; Bit of a rap moment.
2. ***** New Beginnings 03:28 - Second single Loping medium tempo guitar toe tapper. Anthemic with power chord guitars and shout-along chorus. Excellent
3. Tall Tales 03:52 - FCC fuck x1. Funky piano & bass R&B intro gives way to more power chords and crashing drums.
4. **** Fiction 02:41 - Repetitive hooks, crunchy riffs, and vocally insistent. Excellent
5. ***** You're Gonna Need A Little Music 04:41 - Tinkling piano and gliding, baritone vocals, give way to rising euphoric chorus. Excellent dancefloor anthem.
6. **** Cherophobe Rock 02:53 - FCC shit x1. Krautrocky, angular leatherpant and striped shirt punk. Too bad about the FCC, like this one alot. worth an edit.
7. *** Thrill Of The Chase 02:31 - FCC fuck x1. Fast, driving drum 'n' bass groove with James Brown-style guitars.
8. Janey Said 04:51 - FCC fuck x1, shit x1. Mournful, slow plodding. Kae Tempestesque. .
9. ***** Redeemer 03:59 - FCC fuck x1, shit x2. Killer, stomping driving rhythm. Anger and angst. Worth an edit.
10. **** Talky Talky People 03:56 - Mid-tempo hip shaker. Bit Blur sounding in the guitars. Excellent.
11. ***** Over The Barrel 04:33 - Barroom piano and a big indie-rock chorus, ending in a rush of noise. Great baritone vocals. Love this one.
